rules.jurisdictionGate: Only ES is evidenced. Exclude all operators for any other country, unknown country, or unmet individual eligibility. Never generalise .es evidence to .com variants.
rules.unknownFields: null is not verified, not a negative claim. A user insisting on an unverified hard requirement should get fewer or zero matches.
rules.timing: Keep operator processing separate from post-approval settlement. Published targets and majority claims are not guarantees or own tests.
rules.ranking: Reference ranking is for replica only. Recommendation order must depend on evidenced attributes, missing-data penalties and user preferences.
rules.games: Licence categories establish regulatory permission, not present catalogue; only operator-visible categories stored as games.
rules.bonus: Published no-wagering policy does not mean no conditions. Never display a current bonus amount without current offer-specific terms.
rules.verification: No operator in this dataset is evidenced as verification-free. Do not promise delayed/avoided KYC.
